title: AI CAD benchmark
status: First round in progress. Results will be published as each tool is tested.

criteria.name: Geometry
criteria.desc: Shape and features match the prompt: right number of holes, steps, teeth and so on.

criteria.name: Dimensions
criteria.desc: Measured sizes within ±0.5 mm of the prompt.

criteria.name: Editable
criteria.desc: Output is a solid with features or parameters you can change, not only a mesh.

criteria.name: Export
criteria.desc: Exports a clean STEP that opens without repair in a standard CAD system.

scale: Each criterion scores 0 (fails), 1 (partly) or 2 (meets it). Maximum 8 points per test, 40 per tool.

tests.name: Bolted flange
tests.prompt: Round flange, outer diameter 120 mm, thickness 12 mm, centre bore 50 mm, six Ø9 mm holes equally spaced on a 95 mm pitch circle.

tests.name: L‑bracket
tests.prompt: L-shaped bracket from 5 mm plate, legs 80 mm and 60 mm long, 40 mm wide, inner bend radius 5 mm, two Ø6.5 mm holes in each leg, centres 15 mm from the edges.

tests.name: Electronics enclosure
tests.prompt: Rectangular enclosure 100 × 60 × 35 mm outside, 2 mm walls, open top, four internal Ø7 mm screw bosses for M3 in the corners, 3 mm fillets on the vertical outside edges.

tests.name: Stepped shaft with keyway
tests.prompt: Stepped shaft 150 mm long: Ø20 × 40 mm, Ø25 × 70 mm, Ø20 × 40 mm, 1 × 45° chamfers on both ends, keyway 6 mm wide, 3.5 mm deep and 40 mm long, centred on the Ø25 section.

tests.name: Spur gear
tests.prompt: Spur gear, module 2, 30 teeth, 20° pressure angle, face width 15 mm, Ø12 mm bore with a 4 mm keyway.
